meta.description: A private, local-first decision tool for comparing options against criteria you define.
meta.ogTitle: AHP Decision Lab · Make a choice you can explain
privacy.badge: Private by design · Runs in this browser
hero.kicker: A PRIVATE, GENERAL PURPOSE DECISION TOOL
hero.title: Make a choice you can explain.
hero.description: Define the options and criteria that matter to you. Compare them two at a time, see how the result is calculated, and test how sensitive it is to your priorities.
hero.privacy: Your decision stays in this browser unless you export or share the JSON file. No account or personal profile is involved.
setup.title: Start with a blank workspace
options.title: Options
options.question: What are you choosing between?
options.hint: Add 2–10 options. Examples: offers, plans, locations, tools, or project ideas.
criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.question: What makes one option better for you?
criteria.hint: Add 2–10 criteria. Use distinct, relevant factors that reflect your decision.
setup.incomplete: Add at least two options and two criteria to begin comparing. (Currently {options} options and {criteria} criteria.)
judgments.title: Pairwise comparisons
judgments.help: For each pair, choose which matters more and by how much. Equal is a valid judgment.
judgments.scaleHelp: A value of 3 means the left item is moderately preferred. A value of 1/3 means the right item is preferred.
judgments.note: These are your judgments. They are not facts or probabilities. Add a short reason beside a comparison if useful.
results.title: Your results
results.caveat: Shares summarize your stated preferences. They are not probabilities or guarantees.
results.scenarioCaveat: Scenario scores change one criterion weight directly. They do not describe a new set of pairwise comparisons.
results.crGuideline: CR ≤ 0.10 is a common review guideline
scenario.title: Would a different priority change the leader?
scenario.description: Vary one criterion's weight while keeping the other criteria in the same relative proportions.
scenario.apply: Use this scenario in the result above
scenario.chartLabel: Scenario preference scores as criterion weight changes
scenario.leaderStable: The leader stays the same across the 0–100% scenario range.
method.title: From your comparisons to a ranked list
method.step1.title: Compare pairs
method.step1.body: You express a relative preference on Saaty's 1–9 scale. Reverse comparisons are filled in as reciprocals.
method.step2.title: Calculate priorities
method.step2.body: The selected solver turns each comparison matrix into weights that sum to one.
method.step3.title: Review consistency
method.step3.body: The consistency ratio flags comparisons that may conflict. It measures coherence, not correctness.
method.step4.title: Combine the results
method.step4.body: Each option's local priority is multiplied by each criterion's weight and summed.
method.warning: AHP organizes your judgments; it does not discover objective truth. Review the criteria, comparisons, and evidence behind your choice.
audit.title: Calculation details
privacy.title: Privacy and your files
privacy.body: This app has no account or analytics. Your editable workspace is saved in local storage on this browser. Export JSON to back it up or move it; the file contains all options, criteria, comparisons, and notes you entered.
privacy.clearHelp: Use Clear workspace to remove the saved model from this browser and start over. This does not delete JSON files you exported.
footer.promise: Your criteria. Your judgments. Your decision.
message.storageUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. Export your decision to keep a copy.
message.importFailed: Could not import this decision. Check that the JSON file is valid and complete.
